name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-memory
description: Long-term local memory for AI agents: typed records, semantic search and a project knowledge graph.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Storage backend: Sqlite - single-file database with sqlite-vec (default), Postgres - PostgreSQL with pgvector.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: Data directory. Default: ~/.s3l-mcp-memory.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_CONNECTION_STRING
environmentVariables.description: Database location. Sqlite: bare file path or 'Data Source=...' (default {Directory}/memory.db). Postgres: the full connection string, required.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Workspace partition: everything written is tagged with it and reads are narrowed to it, so several people can share one database. Empty: the whole shared base.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to switch embeddings off; records are stored without vectors and recall falls back to text matching.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path of the ONNX embedding model. Default: {Directory}/models/model.onnx, downloaded on first use (multilingual-e5-small, ~118 MB).

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_TOKENIZER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path of the SentencePiece tokenizer. Default: {Directory}/models/sentencepiece.bpe.model, downloaded on first use.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Vector length of the configured model. Default: 384.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_IDLE_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes without an embedding before the model is released from memory; the next embedding loads it again. 0 keeps it loaded. Default: 30.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD
environmentVariables.description: Cosine similarity above which remember refuses a near-duplicate and offers supersession. Default: 0.95.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_SIMILARITY_FLOOR
environmentVariables.description: Cosine similarity below which a search hit is dropped. Default: 0.75.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes without a tool call before an orphaned server process shuts itself down. Default: 60.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_AUDIT_INTERVAL_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days between background audit runs that re-scan records and queue pending link suggestions; 0 disables the audit. Default: 7.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_MEMORY_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Http: one server for every session of the machine, at the loopback address the package names.
